title: Mixed Event — Relaxing Tea Time — Episode7 Great Minds Think Alike

meta.Event Outline: In the lead-up to White Day, Kanade begins thinking about how to express her gratitude for the Valentine's chocolate she received, as well as for all the help she's been given. As she's struggling to think of gifts, she learns that Ichika is having the same dilemma, and the two team up!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... Oh, this looks like the tea shop we saw online.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
They have so many different types...
We should be able to find exactly what everyone needs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, this is actually really exciting!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still... I couldn't believe it when it turned out that we'd come up with the same idea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me neither. Wanting to help everyone relax after working so hard is one thing, but the odds of us both deciding to buy them tea seem astronomical.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why did you decide to get tea, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The tea Ms. Mochizuki always buys really helps calm my nerves whenever I drink it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I thought that tea could help do the same for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, let's do our best to find some tea that everyone is going to love!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, hey!
What a pleasant surprise!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
Are you two here to shop for that segment?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. Are you two here because you decided on what gifts to get?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, we both gave it a lot of thought and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: ...and so, we decided to buy everyone tea.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Yeah, that does sound nice and relaxing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You two made a great choice! But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you're gonna get them tea, then why not take it one step further by actually serving it to them?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll call it Operation: White Day Tea Party!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You want to give everyone a chance to relax, right, Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, instead of just giving them the tea...
Why not throw them a tea party where they can have both a fun and relaxing time?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I agree! It'd be so much fun to have a tea party together when it's nice out!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And they'd probably really enjoy it...
Especially Honami.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I agree...
Mizuki and the others as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What do you say?
We'd be more than happy to help you two with this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll help as much as you need!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... B-But... I'm not sure how I'll do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's give it a try, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I want to give it a try.
Because I can't think of anything that would make me happier than seeing them all smile at this tea party.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You want them to feel relaxed, and I want them to see them smile...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I think this tea party will allow us to accomplish both.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We have a lot to prepare...
But let's start by picking a nice location!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Where can we have a tea party with everyone...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There are going to be a lot of people, we'd need so somewhere with enough space for all of us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Someone's home might be too small...
So, I guess we'd need to rent a big room or hold it outside...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, then... How about that place?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, napkins, garbage bags, plates... I think that's everything we need.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm getting everything ready for White Day.
We're throwing a tea party.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Our plan is to give everyone a chance to relax since they're always working so hard.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
So, Mafuyu, would you like to join us...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I...think I'm okay. I don't know if it counts as feeling relaxed, but I feel at ease here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I actually got some tea just for you, Mafuyu. So, if you decide to change your mind, it'd be nice to see you there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, but you don't have to force yourself to go. We can always have your tea here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Where are you having this tea party?
